name: Warn 4 x 4 Hubs - Stainless Steel
description: Designed for hardcore off-roaders and constructed to take any beating you dish out, Warns 4 x 4 Hubs deliver nothing less than the industry standard in durability and performance. Hubs are easy to install, feature easy-turn dials and are simple to maintain. Backed by Warns limited lifetime warranty. Made in USA. Available: Premium Locking Hubs for Ford Super Duty Trucks Compatible with Ford Super Duty Trucks model year 2005 and newer, these hubs feature heat-treated gears, all-metal caps and dials, and marine-grade, corrosion-resistant stainless steel hardware. Heat-treated cro-moly steel gears and bearing housing provide enhanced strength and durability. Unique cartridge design makes installation and disassembly a breeze. Premium Manual Hubs All-metal ZA alloy dial with dual seals keeps contaminants out. Thick internal wave spring technology and heavy dial detents ensure the inner drive gear and clutch ring are engaged. Color: Stainless Steel. Type: Hubs.
